output.subject: We've received your complaint about a duplicate charge from Coastline Auto Body
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about the charges on your credit card. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm what you've told us.

You mentioned that Coastline Auto Body charged your credit card twice for the same visit on August 27, and that two charges of $1,260.00 appeared a few minutes apart. You told us that when you contacted the merchant, they said they could see only one charge on their end and advised you to call your bank. You've asked us to remove the duplicate charge.

We understand how unsettling it is to see an unexpected charge of this size, especially after you have already tried to sort it out with the merchant. We're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Mode is ACKNOWLEDGE ONLY: the complaint is with Fraud & Disputes, so the draft names no department and takes no position.
Confirm on the card account referenced in the complaint whether both $1,260.00 charges have posted, or whether one is still a pending authorization.
Decide whether any provisional credit or dispute step applies; the draft only acknowledges the customer's request to remove the duplicate.
Check the dates and timestamps of both transactions against the customer's account of August 27.
Consider asking the customer for a receipt or invoice from Coastline Auto Body if the specialist team needs it.
